screens.title: Yak Software — independent engineering and research, Andorra
screens.description: Yak Software is an independent engineering and research company in Andorra, working on dictation, coding agents, consensus protocols and financial infrastructure — systems whose guarantees hold without trusting whoever runs them.

screens.title: Diane — private dictation of the highest quality — Yak Software
screens.description: Diane is dictation of the highest quality, into any application on any device, that stays confidential. In daily use on Windows, with an Android companion at concept stage.
injectHtml: <script>(function(){var q=function(n){return document.querySelector('[data-dc-anim="'+n+'"]');};var dict=q("dict"),mic=q("mic"),icon=q("mic-icon"),timer=q("mic-timer");if(!dict||!mic||!icon||!timer)return;var words="The short version: keep the current plan, move the review to Thursday, and ask for the updated numbers before we send anything out.".split(" ");var chunks=[[4,6],[10,12],[17,18]];var base="width:4.6cqw;height:4.6cqw;border-radius:50%;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;box-sizing:border-box;transition:background .3s,border-color .3s;";var tick=31;function frame(){var shown=0,i;for(i=0;i<chunks.length;i++)if(tick>=chunks[i][0])shown=chunks[i][1];if(tick>=31)shown=words.length;dict.textContent=words.slice(0,shown).join(" ")+(shown&&shown<words.length?" ":"");if(tick<25){mic.style.cssText=base+"background:#c3401f;animation:pulse 1.2s ease-in-out infinite";icon.style.opacity="1";icon.setAttribute("stroke","#f1ece2");icon.querySelector("rect").setAttribute("fill","#f1ece2");timer.textContent="0:"+String(15+tick).padStart(2,"0");}else if(tick<31){mic.style.cssText=base+"background:#f1ece2;border:0.28cqw solid #d8d0bf;border-top-color:#c3401f;box-shadow:0 0.5cqw 1.2cqw rgba(58,55,51,.22);animation:spin .9s linear infinite";icon.style.opacity="0";icon.setAttribute("stroke","#7a7368");icon.querySelector("rect").setAttribute("fill","#7a7368");timer.textContent="";}else{mic.style.cssText=base+"background:#f1ece2;border:0.28cqw solid #3a3733;box-shadow:0 0.5cqw 1.2cqw rgba(58,55,51,.22)";icon.style.opacity="1";icon.setAttribute("stroke","#7a7368");icon.querySelector("rect").setAttribute("fill","#7a7368");timer.textContent="";}tick=(tick+1)%36;}frame();setInterval(frame,400);})();</script>

screens.title: agent-cage — run AI coding agents unattended — Yak Software
screens.description: agent-cage runs AI coding agents on your own servers, unattended, from a chat — with exactly the permissions they need and nothing more. In active use; public release 1 October 2026.

screens.title: Molt Petit — a machine-checked consensus protocol — Yak Software
screens.description: Molt Petit is a consensus protocol small enough to understand in a minute, with deterministic fast finality, machine-checked from the Rust implementation to Lean 4 theorems. The consensus core of Ledger.

screens.title: Ledger — records that stay correct and private — Yak Software
screens.description: Ledger keeps company records correct, and private, even when someone inside — human or AI — has access to every server. Built on the proven Molt Petit consensus core.

screens.title: Research — proof-driven development — Yak Software
screens.description: AI agents change the economics of formal verification: for some software, properties that were too expensive to prove can become part of normal development. Molt Petit is the first substantial result.

screens.title: Consulting — architecture, protocols and systems — Yak Software
screens.description: Software architecture, protocols and reliable systems, built or fixed with extreme rigour so they run nearly all the time with minimal maintenance. Available in limited capacity.

screens.title: About — Yak Software
screens.description: Yak Software is an independent engineering and research company in Andorra, founded and led by George Agapov, building systems that have to be right when nobody is watching.

screens.title: Contact — Yak Software
screens.description: Get in touch with Yak Software: george@yak.ad, or on Telegram, X, GitHub and LinkedIn. Replies come from a person, usually within a day, Central European time.

screens.title: Financial systems — Yak Software
screens.description: Financial systems from Yak Software: a ledger and the consensus protocol beneath it — infrastructure where being wrong is unrecoverable, and the reasoning behind it.
